errors.evidence: The purple line representing the 'Vanilla' model has triangle markers, not star markers.
The orange line representing 'SepLLM (n=64)' has plus sign (+) markers, not dash markers.
The blue line representing 'SepLLM (n=128)' has 'x' markers, not square markers.
The green line representing 'SepLLM (n=64, H)' has diamond markers, not triangle markers.
For the SepLLM (n=64) line, the value at 9e8 TFLOPs is approximately 100%, not 99.8%.
The SepLLM (n=128) line starts exactly at 97%, not 96.8%.
The SepLLM (n=64, H) line starts at approximately 97.5%, making 98% a poor approximation.

The final value for the SepLLM (n=64, H) line at 9e8 TFLOPs is approximately 99.8%, not 99.6%.
For the SepLLM (n=64, H/T) line, this point is not its peak. The actual peak occurs at 4e8 TFLOPs with a value of approximately 99.1%.
